text: 金十数据11月9日讯，天眼查法律诉讼信息显示，11月5日和6日，华夏幸福基业股份有限公司等新增3则被执行人信息，执行标的合计16.8亿余元人民币，执行法院为固安县人民法院、大厂回族自治县人民法院。该公司成立于1993年5月，法定代表人为王文学，注册资本约39.14亿人民币，经营范围包括房地产中介服务、提供施工设备服务、企业管理咨询等，由华夏幸福基业控股股份公司、鼎基资本管理有限公司、浙江春晖集团有限公司等共同持股。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 9: Tianyancha legal proceedings information shows that on November 5 and 6, China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. and others added three pieces of information as persons subject to enforcement, with total enforcement标的 of more than RMB 1.68 billion. The enforcing courts are Gu'an County People's Court and Dachang Hui Autonomous County People's Court. The company was established in May 1993, with Wang Wenxue as legal representative and registered capital of approximately RMB 3.914 billion. Its business scope includes real estate intermediary services, provision of construction equipment services, enterprise management consulting, etc. It is jointly held by China Fortune Land Development Holding Co., Ltd., Dingji Capital Management Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Chunhui Group Co., Ltd. and others.
